items.title: “Keep it simple. One thing you're doing, …”
items.where: Please don’t put six metaphors in one trance, P1
items.your_version:
Please don’t put six metaphors in one trance

"Keep it simple, stupid!" (KISS principle). It's really easy to take a whole bunch of techniques from all of this and make something so complicated that you "hypnotize" yourself to the point where you don't even know if it worked or not. So start off with setting one anchor/image. Decide on a hypnotic tone (warm, indirect, direct, neutral witnessing, etc.) for the session. If you're going to use metaphors, just start with one, and if you switch metaphors midway, understand the purpose of the switch. Then plan a simple stepwise walk out of the subsconscious at session end.
items.my_version: Keep it simple. One thing you're doing, one anchor/image you're going with at first, one way of coming back, and feel free to set a tone (warm, bounded, directed, neutral witnessing, whatever) for yourself. If you're going to use metaphors just do one, and if you switch metaphors, do it in a way that's conscious.

items.title: “Using metaphors and imagery is entirely optional. …”
items.where: Please don’t put six metaphors in one trance, P2
items.your_version: Using metaphors and imagery is your call. You can use whatever form of inner signal that you notice. It may be a direct knowing, or an emotion, words, some kind of rhythm, movements or other kind of spatial perception. Keep the language tied to the subconscious world you've chosen, so if you're counting, and there are already raindrops falling, you can count the raindrops, for example. When you're done, come back the opposite way from how you went in. You can borrow qualities such as warmth or steadiness from someone who models them, but don't change who you are.

items.title: “Long, elegant sentences don't read well when …”

items.title: “(The part below called "Already open? Contain …”
items.your_version: Put yourself in a place where you can safely do this, which is not: driving a big machine, swimming with the fishies, or otherwise needing to be alert and functionally responsible for yourself or others. If you are intoxicated and/or more confused than usual, or for whatever reason not able to keep yourself safe, then get some immediate support instead of doing exploratory hypnosis. (The part below called "Already open? Contain before you deepen" can be used to help orient you if you're already open, but don't use it to make yourself deeper if you're not stable.)
items.my_version:
Put yourself in a place where you can safely do this. Don't do this if you're driving, in the water, operating machinery, or otherwise need to be attending to yourself or other people. If you are intoxicated, acutely confused, or not able to keep yourself safe, then get some immediate support instead of doing exploratory hypnosis. (The part below called "Already open? Contain before you deepen" can be used to help orient you if you're already open, but don't use it to make yourself deeper if you're not stable.)

Deciding to do it: how will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Make it firmer, so you stay with a feeling? Something else? Preview what you are going to do: will you close your eyes? Will you come out and go back in again? What will you do at the end? If you are going to use a recording, read the script beforehand if you can. Know that you can say "stop" at any time and the induction will end. If you want to change something, say "less" if you want it to be asking for less from you, or say "quiet" and the talking will stop. You can also just open your eyes and stop, and then come all the way back anyway. You don't need to ask any parts for permission to stop, even if a part tells you that you do.

items.title: “Instead of getting more relaxed with the …”
items.where: Make the hypnosis more active, P1
items.your_version:
If being still tends to make you sleepy, zone out, or wish you were out (escapism), no worries, there's a trick for that. Instead of getting more relaxed with the hypnosis, try getting more alert (it's still relaxed-alert, not paranoid-alert). Keep your eyes open. Use a small hand movement each time you make the auto-suggestion that you're gaining increasing clarity. Then stop the hand movement and see where your mind is at. That hand movement is the mental escape into the body's flow. Say something like,
“Starting with your eyes open, press your thumb to your forefinger. And as you press your fingers together gently and release, you begin to bring yourself into a place of clearer awareness… again you press your fingers together and release, bringing yourself into an even clearer state of awareness. And again as you press your fingers together and release, you bring yourself into a clear state of awareness. And now you stop pressing your fingers together, and in the first second after you stop pressing your fingers together deliberately, you can notice if there is any sensory echo of the pressing in your fingers, in your breathing, in your attention, or nowhere at all. Just notice, sit up straight and work from this level."

items.title: “Love above, Child below, Adult present”
items.your_version:
Imagine a divine Love from above, with the inner child below, in the solar plexus area. The inner adult is present. You can also use the hand on the solar plexus to massage that area. Say:

“Sending my love down to my Child. If something comes back up, I let it, and send my love on down again. If nothing comes back, I just keep sending mine, and listening.”

Sleep induction is different than inner work, where you need to come back up to write things down and do actions.

You can tell your analytical mind to stand down, any revelations can wait.

items.title: “Before accepting a recording or live suggestion …”
items.your_version:
Before accepting a hypnotic recording or live suggestion, ask these important questions to avoid being manipulated:

What induction mechanics are being used to bring me under the spell?
Can my responses lead to pausing or modifying the script,  or stopping & coming to full alertness?
Does the hypnotist treat my lack of awarenes of what's going on as some kind of proof that the process worked?
Is the hypnotist using identity roles, obedience ladders, age regressions, or desires for/assumptions of belonging to lower my adult self's better judgment? 

Keep in mind though, the answer to that last one requires either checking the script first, or explaining what your adult judgement would accept, as the hypnotist can't be expected to know that.

Continuing with the job interview:
Are fractionation, cues, or other methods of affecting my memory or modifying my post-session behavior disclosed before they are used? 
Is the hypnotist implicitly turning my bodily sensations into evidence for a prior assumption?

When we're ready to exit hypnosis, will they give me a clear statement that the session has ended, and would I get back my normal waking (and walking) identity? Will I be able to use my critical judgement abilities as before?

When any answer to these questions is unclear, beware. Ask for the exact script. If they don't want to give it, change the method, or walk right out that door.

items.title: “You’ve got lots of other options for …”
items.my_version: Work with the body. Sometimes the mind is too activated for meditation to help, so you may need to work directly with the body to calm it down. Maybe get a massage, or massage a foot, your scalp, a temple, or the back of the neck, the top of a shoulder, etc. (Avoid massaging the front of the neck. Also avoid massaging injured or numb body parts, or bruised, inflamed, or recently surgically operated on areas, or varicose veins. Also stop if the massage makes the anxiety symptoms worse, or makes you feel bad in any way, such as painful, dizzy, tingly, etc.) You’ve got lots of other options for the body too, like heat, pressure, a weighted blanket, darkness, your favorite calming music, or a massage gun if you’re careful with it, etc. Use whatever actually helps you, and don’t go surrounding the anxiety with a heap of wellness stuff.

items.title: “While you're building a way to reach …”
items.your_version: A lot of people have had dramatic openings to love at some point in their life. If you've had a similar experience, you know that there is a difference between having experienced it at one point, or only being able to access it in a certain state, and being able to get to it at any point in your life. While you're building a way to reach love on a normal day, let that experience  you had serve as a reference point for what can happen. (If you can't give that love to the child, try to deal with why you can't, instead of trying to ramp up the experience. Often there's a child guard part that’s seen love come with strings  or get revoked before in a painful way. Love starts with hearing out the resistance to it first.)

items.your_version:
so this one was human, about 70% of it high conf the rest med conf:

For the no trance inner contact, I would follow something along the lines of these steps:

For pacing (warm-up), notice reality as it is now: what you can see, what day of the week it is, that you can read or that you still have your feet, etc.

For the suggestion: in your mind, ask a clear question and then listen gently.

Now keep your sense of agency during the answer phase. You might notice an answer popped up, or you might decide you don't know. You can always take a break or rephrase the question. Sometimes you might ask advice from someone else.

Keep aware of the sutble inner signal: write whatever you get. It might be a word or sensation. An impulse or objection. Sometimes there's no signal, just silence, itself a kind of signal. Don't jump to interpreting it as validation of some theory.

Hand off the role: have your adult self answer that same question in whatever way is appropriate, preferably by writing or doing.

Integration/exit: reality test the signal you noticed. As part of testing, if it seems appropriate, you can do something simple based on it.

There's no elaborate exit protocol here since you didn't go into trance. Just close the exercise and carry on with your day.
